_comment: Terms of use of the sources this server reaches, applied when SGM_RESPECT_TERMS is true (the default). automated_access=false: the host is never fetched. Hosts not listed here are only subject to robots.txt. Add an entry when a source's terms are reviewed; keep the terms URL so the decision can be checked.

zefix.ch.note: Web application for people, not an API. Company data comes from the federal UID register web service (uid-wse.admin.ch) instead.

geo.admin.ch.note: Federal Spatial Data Infrastructure: free use without registration, subject to fair use (moderate request volumes). Covers api3.geo.admin.ch and data.geo.admin.ch.

transport.opendata.ch.note: Public API; its rate limit is that of timetable.search.ch. Answers are cached for 60 s.
